_id: GOLDEN rung for G5S20R4. Built on golden_baseline_multi.json via _extends, so every sigma, bias and process-noise value is the sourced one (docs/golden_baseline_provenance.md) and a change to the golden propagates here automatically. The delta below is the formation size and the two-way time-transfer toggle, nothing else.
_delta: nSpaceAssets 20 instead of the multi golden's 6, on the same 1000 m helix, so the ring chord spacing tightens from about 1000 m to about 313 m, inside the 200-500 m gap band of the originating swarm concept.
